stages.title: AI foundations
stages.description: Understand the vocabulary and build your Python baseline.
tasks: Explain AI, ML, deep learning and generative AI in your own words.
Practice Python functions, lists, dictionaries and a small data-cleaning script.
Review vectors, matrices, probability and descriptive statistics.
stages.deliverable: Build a notebook that cleans a small dataset and explains five AI concepts.

stages.title: Data & machine learning
stages.description: Learn to measure a model before adding complexity.
tasks: Explore a dataset with pandas and document missing values.
Train a simple regression or classification baseline with a held-out test set.
Explain overfitting, data leakage, precision and recall.
stages.deliverable: Deliver a reproducible baseline notebook with an error analysis. Your saved collection has few core ML tutorials; these are added practice milestones.

stages.title: LLMs & context
stages.description: Move from ad hoc prompts to repeatable experiments.
tasks: Explain tokens, embeddings, context windows and transformer attention.
Compare three prompt variants against the same ten examples.
Compare prompting, retrieval and fine-tuning for one use case.
stages.deliverable: Create a prompt experiment log with examples, scores and failure cases.

stages.title: Retrieval & RAG
stages.description: Connect answers to evidence you can inspect.
tasks: Chunk a small document collection and retrieve relevant passages.
Build a question-answer flow that cites retrieved sources.
Measure retrieval quality and test unanswerable questions.
stages.deliverable: Build a knowledge assistant evaluated against twenty questions.

stages.title: Agents & orchestration
stages.description: Give a bounded workflow tools, state and clear limits.
tasks: Build one tool-using agent with a small, explicit goal.
Add state, retry limits and a human approval step for external actions.
Compare a fixed workflow with a dynamic agent on the same task.
stages.deliverable: Deliver a research assistant with a trace of every tool call.

stages.title: Evaluation & production
stages.description: Make your capstone measurable and reliable.
tasks: Create an evaluation set covering success cases and expected failures.
Track task success, latency, cost and groundedness.
Document access controls, monitoring, rollback and known limitations.
stages.deliverable: Finish a portfolio case study with a demo, evaluation results and architecture diagram.
